description: After fz-bin.12 raises the fz2 frontdoor drive budget enough for fixtures2/behavior/enum_take_drop_split.fz to pass semantic closure, the fixture exposes downstream execution failures. fz2 interp prints four [] lines then exits with 'backend value 0 is unbound'. fz2 run reaches native codegen and panics at src/compiler2/native_codegen/fn_ctx.rs:827: index out of bounds: len is 2 but index is 2. fz2 build succeeds, but the produced binary exits 0 with no stdout for an output-bearing fixture. Investigate backend/native execution and output correctness before re-enabling enum_take_drop_split.
title: Enum take/drop/split execution fails after compiler drive completes
